generated.what_happened: Fox Sports has removed Dave Portnoy and Barstool Sports personalities from its college football pregame show, 'Big Noon Kickoff,' after just over a year of appearances. Sources cited the unsustainable challenge of blending Barstool's edgy style with Fox's more traditional format and its Big Ten network partnership as the primary factor. Portnoy alleged that Ohio State and head coach Ryan Day forced the decision by threatening Fox's access over his commentary, though Ohio State previously denied interfering and referred inquiries to Fox. The departure only impacts the pregame broadcast and will not affect the weekday FS1 program 'Wake-Up Barstool.'
